Appearance:
MR PRATIK Y JASANI(5325) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR MANAN MEHTA, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 MR AR KADRI, for the Respondent(s) No. 2 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SAMIR J. DAVE  Date : 23/03/2023

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER Mr. A. R. Kadri,

learned advocate states that he has received instructions to appear for and on behalf of the respondent no.2 and sought permission to appear on behalf of the respondent no.2.
Permission; as sought for; stands granted.
He shall file his Vakalatnama before the Registry.
Registry shall accept the same.

1. Rule. Learned APP waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent no.1-State and learned advocate Mr. A. R. Kadri waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent no.2.
2.

Considering the issue involved in the present application and with consent of the learned advocates appearing for the R/CR.MA/655/2023 ORDER DATED: 23/03/2023 respective parties as well as considering the fact that the dispute amongst the applicant and complainant has been resolved amicably, this matter is taken up for final disposal forthwith.

sentences.text: By way of this application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (hereinafter referred to as "the Code"), the applicant has prayed for quashing and setting aside FIR being C.R.No. PART-B -11202006200014 of 2020 registered with Bedi Marine Police Station, District Jamnagar for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(i), 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4, 6 and 12 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO) Act as well as other consequential proceedings arising therefrom.

entities.text: Bedi Marine Police Station, District Jamnagar
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the respective parties submitted that during pendency of the criminal proceedings, as referred to above, the parties have amicably settled their issue by way of mutual settlement and pursuant to understanding arrived at, the Complainant has accordingly filed an affidavit, which is on record.

The complainant has categorically stated in the affidavit that dispute is amicably resolved and has no objections if the present proceedings are quashed and there is no surviving grievance between them.
5. Heard learned advocates for the respective parties.

R/CR.MA/655/2023 ORDER DATED: 23/03/2023 6. Having heard the learned counsel for the respective parties, considering the facts and circumstances arising out of the present application as well as taking into consideration the decisions rendered in the cases of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr., reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303, Madan Mohan Abbot Vs. State of Punjab, reported in (2008) 4 SCC 582, Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr., reported in 2009 (1) GLH 31, Manoj Sharma Vs. State &
Ors., reported in 2009 (1) GLH 190 and Narinder Singh & Ors. Vs. State of Punjab & Anr. reported in 2014 (2) Crime 67 (SC), it appears that further continuation of criminal proceedings in relation to the impugned FIR against the applicant would be unnecessary harassment to the applicant.

sentences.text:
It appears that the trial would be futile and further continuance of the proceedings pursuant to the impugned FIR would amount to abuse of process of law and Court and hence, to secure the ends of justice, the impugned FIR and other consequential proceedings are required to be quashed and set aside in exercise of powers conferred under Section 482 of the Code.
7.
Resultantly, this application is allowed.

The impugned FIR being C.R.No. PART-B -11202006200014 of 2020 registered with Bedi Marine Police Station, District Jamnagar as well as other consequential proceedings are hereby quashed and set R/CR.MA/655/2023 ORDER DATED:
23/03/2023 aside qua the present applicant herein.

entities.text: Bedi Marine Police Station, District Jamnagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Accordingly, Rule is made absolute.
8. If the applicant is behind bar, Jail authority as well as Court concerned shall take necessary steps to release the applicant from the jail if he is not required in any other offence.
Direct service is permitted.
